# Copilot for business users - official Microsoft sources

Canonical Microsoft URLs for **teaching Copilot to end users**, collected 17 August 2026. These back the two Copilot courses - [[Copilot Chat to 365 Copilot]] and [[Intermediate to Advanced Copilot]] - and the adoption conversation that sits around a client rollout. The companion note [[Copilot Studio - official documentation]] covers agent _building_; this note covers agent and Copilot _use_. What these sources were turned into lives in [[Copilot concept map for business users]] and [[Copilot glossary for business users]]. Part of [[_worksmart-ai]].

**Treat these as live sources, not as a cached answer.** Microsoft ships into Copilot monthly and the UI in a screenshot dates fast. Anything lifted into course material needs a stated review date.

## Free structured training (Microsoft Learn)

| Resource                                                         | What it covers                                                                                               | URL                                                                                           |
| ---------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Copilot learning hub                                             | Entry point for everything below                                                                             | https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/copilot/                                                    |
| Work Smarter with AI using Microsoft Copilot                     | Single module, explicitly aimed at business users                                                            | https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/training/modules/explore-microsoft-copilot-business-users/  |
| Draft, analyze, and present with Microsoft 365 Copilot (MS-4018) | Prompt flows in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, Outlook. The closest thing to a standard end-user curriculum | https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/training/paths/get-started-with-microsoft-365-copilot/      |
| Transform ideas into action with Copilot Chat (Basic)            | For orgs without paid Copilot licences                                                                       | https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/training/paths/explore-microsoft-365-copilot-business-chat/ |

| Microsoft Productivity Accreditation 2026                        | Copilot in Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook, OneNote, and carries a credential                               | https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/training/paths/microsoft-productivity-accreditation-2026/   |
| Copilot Learning Hub (shows)                                     | Video series                                                                                                 | https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/shows/copilot-learning-hub/                                 |

## In-tenant learning surfaces

What a client already has without buying anything. Worth knowing so a proposal is not selling what Microsoft gives away, and so a course can point at it as follow-on practice.

| Surface                         | What it is                                                                                                                                                                    | URL                                                                                                                       |
| ------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Copilot Academy                 | Guided learning inside Viva Learning, on by default for all Microsoft 365 users. Admins can restrict it to licensed users, and can duplicate and tailor it in eight languages | https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/viva/learning/academy-copilot                                                           |
| Copilot Academy, end-user help  | The learner-facing explanation of the same thing                                                                                                                              | https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/topic/microsoft-copilot-academy-in-viva-learning-ffaa43bb-1723-4237-b021-2ed9b924c8e2 |
| Copilot Prompt Gallery          | Microsoft-curated prompts, plus user and team prompts, surfaced inside Copilot and Copilot Chat                                                                               | https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/copilot-prompt-gallery                                            |
| Prompt Gallery, public web view | Microsoft-authored prompts, readable without signing in                                                                                                                       | https://copilot.cloud.microsoft/en-us/prompts                                                                             |
| Prompt Gallery, adoption view   | https://adoption.microsoft.com/en-us/copilot/prompt-gallery/                                                                                                                  |

## Licensing caveat

Microsoft Learn content and the Success Kit are reference material, not licensed for lifting into a paid course. Cite and link rather than adapt. Where a WorkSmart-AI course covers the same ground, it earns its place through the sector framing, the hands-on task, and the institution's own AI policy - not through repeating Microsoft's explanation.
